const SPREADSHEET_ID = 'REPLACE_RESOURCE_ID';

// Legacy sheets kept intact for backward compatibility.
const LEADS_SHEET_NAME = 'Leads';
const EVENTS_SHEET_NAME = 'Events';

// New SAFE #7 sheets. They are created automatically on first use.
const EMAIL_LEADS_SHEET_NAME = 'Lead Magnet Email';
const WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME = 'Waitlist Pendampingan';
const EMAIL_EVENTS_SHEET_NAME = 'Events Lead Magnet';
const ADMIN_EMAIL = 'user_ead0ce67@example.invalid';
const FOLLOWUP_SHEET_NAME = 'Follow-up 5 Hari';
const DASHBOARD_SHEET_NAME = 'Dashboard Lead Magnet';
const CHECKLIST_PDF_BASE64 = '';
const FOLLOWUP_REVIEW_START = '27-28 September 2026';

function doGet() {
  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(
      JSON.stringify({
        ok: true,
        service: 'UMKM Naik Kelas Lead Capture SAFE 8',
        legacyLeadsSheet: LEADS_SHEET_NAME,
        legacyEventsSheet: EVENTS_SHEET_NAME,
        emailLeadsSheet: EMAIL_LEADS_SHEET_NAME,
        waitlistSheet: WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME,
        emailEventsSheet: EMAIL_EVENTS_SHEET_NAME
      })
    )
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}

function doPost(e) {
  const lock = LockService.getScriptLock();
  lock.waitLock(10000);

  try {
    const p = e && e.parameter ? e.parameter : {};
    const action = cleanText_(p.action || 'lead');

    if (action === 'event') return saveLegacyEvent_(p);
    if (action === 'lead_email') return saveEmailLead_(p);
    if (action === 'event_email') return saveEmailEvent_(p);
    if (action === 'waitlist') return saveWaitlist_(p);

    return saveLegacyLead_(p);
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(err);
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: String(err.message || err) });
  } finally {
    lock.releaseLock();
  }
}

function saveEmailLead_(p) {
  const name = cleanText_(p.name);
  const email = cleanText_(p.email).toLowerCase();
  const source = cleanText_(p.source || 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan');
  const page = cleanText_(p.page);
  const utm = readUtm_(p);

  if (!name || !isValidEmail_(email)) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Nama dan email valid wajib diisi.' });
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const headers = [
    'Timestamp', 'Nama', 'Email', 'Source', 'Page', 'Status',
    'UTM Source', 'UTM Medium', 'UTM Campaign', 'UTM Content', 'UTM Term', 'Catatan'
  ];
  const sheet = ensureSheetColumns_(ss, EMAIL_LEADS_SHEET_NAME, headers);

  const existingRow = findRowByHeaderValue_(sheet, 'Email', email);
  if (existingRow) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'lead_email', duplicate: true, message: 'Email sudah tercatat.' });
  }

  appendObjectRow_(sheet, headers, {
    'Timestamp': new Date(), 'Nama': safeCell_(name), 'Email': safeCell_(email),
    'Source': safeCell_(source), 'Page': safeCell_(page), 'Status': 'Lead Baru',
    'UTM Source': safeCell_(utm.utm_source), 'UTM Medium': safeCell_(utm.utm_medium),
    'UTM Campaign': safeCell_(utm.utm_campaign), 'UTM Content': safeCell_(utm.utm_content),
    'UTM Term': safeCell_(utm.utm_term), 'Catatan': ''
  });

  ensureLeadDashboard_(ss);
  return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'lead_email', message: 'Lead email berhasil disimpan.' });
}

function saveWaitlist_(p) {
  const name = cleanText_(p.name);
  const whatsapp = cleanText_(p.whatsapp);
  const email = cleanText_(p.email).toLowerCase();
  const medan1 = cleanText_(p.medan1);
  const medan2 = cleanText_(p.medan2);
  const medan3 = cleanText_(p.medan3);
  const score1 = Number(p.score1);
  const score2 = Number(p.score2);
  const score3 = Number(p.score3);
  const problem = cleanText_(p.problem);
  const target30 = cleanText_(p.target30);
  const source = cleanText_(p.source || 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Waitlist Pendampingan');
  const page = cleanText_(p.page);
  const utm = readUtm_(p);

  if (!name || !whatsapp || !isValidEmail_(email) || !medan1 || !medan2 || !medan3 || !problem || !target30) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Data waitlist belum lengkap.' });
  }
  if (!validDiagnosisScore_(score1) || !validDiagnosisScore_(score2) || !validDiagnosisScore_(score3)) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Skor medan harus 4 sampai 12.' });
  }
  if (new Set([medan1, medan2, medan3]).size !== 3) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Pilih tiga medan yang berbeda.' });
  }

  const averageScore = Math.round(((score1 + score2 + score3) / 3) * 10) / 10;
  const segment = classifyProspect_(averageScore, problem, target30);
  const priority = segment === 'Prospek Panas' ? '1 - Prioritas 27-28 Sep' :
    segment === 'Prospek Hangat' ? '2 - Setelah Prospek Panas' : '3 - Nurture';
  const followUpDate = segment === 'Prospek Panas' ? FOLLOWUP_REVIEW_START : '';

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const headers = [
    'Timestamp', 'Nama', 'Email', 'Medan #1', 'Medan #2', 'Medan #3', 'Masalah Utama',
    'Source', 'Page', 'Status', 'Catatan', 'WhatsApp', 'Skor #1', 'Skor #2', 'Skor #3',
    'Target 30 Hari', 'Rata-rata Skor', 'Segment', 'UTM Source', 'UTM Medium', 'UTM Campaign',
    'UTM Content', 'UTM Term', 'Follow-up Priority', 'Follow-up Berikutnya'
  ];
  const sheet = ensureSheetColumns_(ss, WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME, headers);

  const existingRow = findRowByHeaderValue_(sheet, 'Email', email);
  const rowData = {
    'Timestamp': new Date(), 'Nama': safeCell_(name), 'Email': safeCell_(email),
    'Medan #1': safeCell_(medan1), 'Medan #2': safeCell_(medan2), 'Medan #3': safeCell_(medan3),
    'Masalah Utama': safeCell_(problem), 'Source': safeCell_(source), 'Page': safeCell_(page),
    'Status': 'Waitlist Baru', 'WhatsApp': safeCell_(whatsapp),
    'Skor #1': score1, 'Skor #2': score2, 'Skor #3': score3,
    'Target 30 Hari': safeCell_(target30), 'Rata-rata Skor': averageScore, 'Segment': segment,
    'UTM Source': safeCell_(utm.utm_source), 'UTM Medium': safeCell_(utm.utm_medium),
    'UTM Campaign': safeCell_(utm.utm_campaign), 'UTM Content': safeCell_(utm.utm_content),
    'UTM Term': safeCell_(utm.utm_term), 'Follow-up Priority': priority, 'Follow-up Berikutnya': followUpDate
  };

  if (existingRow) {
    updateObjectRow_(sheet, existingRow, rowData);
    ensureFollowUpQueue_(ss, {
      name, email, medan1, medan2, medan3, source, page, utm
    });
    ensureLeadDashboard_(ss);
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'waitlist', duplicate: true, segment, averageScore, message: 'Waitlist diperbarui.' });
  }

  appendObjectRow_(sheet, headers, Object.assign({}, rowData, { 'Catatan': '' }));
  ensureFollowUpQueue_(ss, {
    name, email, medan1, medan2, medan3, source, page, utm
  });
  ensureLeadDashboard_(ss);

  return jsonResponse_({
    ok: true, type: 'waitlist', segment, averageScore,
    message: 'Waitlist berhasil disimpan.'
  });
}

function saveEmailEvent_(p) {
  const eventName = cleanText_(p.event);
  const name = cleanText_(p.name);
  const email = cleanText_(p.email).toLowerCase();
  const source = cleanText_(p.source || 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan');
  const page = cleanText_(p.page);
  const utm = readUtm_(p);

  const allowedEvents = [
    'LeadMagnetDownload', 'WaitlistOpen', 'WhatsAppAnalysisClick',
    'TripwireFreeAnalysisClick', 'TripwireMiniClassClick'
  ];

  if (!allowedEvents.includes(eventName)) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Event email tidak dikenali.' });
  }
  if (!isValidEmail_(email)) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Email diperlukan untuk event ini.' });
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const headers = [
    'Timestamp', 'Event', 'Nama', 'Email', 'Source', 'Page',
    'UTM Source', 'UTM Medium', 'UTM Campaign', 'UTM Content', 'UTM Term', 'Detail'
  ];
  const sheet = ensureSheetColumns_(ss, EMAIL_EVENTS_SHEET_NAME, headers);

  if (!eventExistsByHeaders_(sheet, eventName, email)) {
    appendObjectRow_(sheet, headers, {
      'Timestamp': new Date(), 'Event': safeCell_(eventName), 'Nama': safeCell_(name), 'Email': safeCell_(email),
      'Source': safeCell_(source), 'Page': safeCell_(page), 'UTM Source': safeCell_(utm.utm_source),
      'UTM Medium': safeCell_(utm.utm_medium), 'UTM Campaign': safeCell_(utm.utm_campaign),
      'UTM Content': safeCell_(utm.utm_content), 'UTM Term': safeCell_(utm.utm_term),
      'Detail': safeCell_(p.segment || '')
    });
  }


  ensureLeadDashboard_(ss);
  return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'event_email', message: 'Event berhasil disimpan.' });
}

function sendWaitlistEmails_(data) {
  const adminEmail = getAdminEmail_();
  let participantSent = false;
  let adminSent = false;
  let error = '';

  try {
    const participantSubject = 'Waitlist Pendampingan — UMKM Naik Kelas';
    const participantPlain = [
      'Halo ' + data.name + ',',
      '',
      'Terima kasih. Data waitlist pendampingan Anda sudah kami terima.',
      '',
      '3 medan terendah Anda:',
      '1. ' + data.medan1,
      '2. ' + data.medan2,
      '3. ' + data.medan3,
      '',
      'Masalah utama:',
      data.problem,
      '',
      'Tim UMKM Naik Kelas akan meninjau hasil diagnosis Anda. Jika tersedia slot yang sesuai, kami akan menghubungi Anda.',
      '',
      'UMKM Naik Kelas',
      'https://umkmnaikkelas.id'
    ].join('\n');

    const participantMail = {
      to: data.email,
      subject: participantSubject,
      body: participantPlain,
      htmlBody: buildParticipantWaitlistHtml_(data),
      name: 'UMKM Naik Kelas'
    };
    if (adminEmail) participantMail.replyTo = adminEmail;
    MailApp.sendEmail(participantMail);
    participantSent = true;
  } catch (err) {
    error = 'Peserta: ' + String(err.message || err);
  }

  if (adminEmail) {
    try {
      const adminSubject = 'Waitlist Baru Pendampingan — UMKM Naik Kelas';
      const adminPlain = [
        'Ada waitlist pendampingan baru.',
        '',
        'Nama: ' + data.name,
        'Email: ' + data.email,
        'Medan #1: ' + data.medan1,
        'Medan #2: ' + data.medan2,
        'Medan #3: ' + data.medan3,
        'Masalah utama: ' + data.problem,
        'Source: ' + data.source,
        'Page: ' + data.page
      ].join('\n');

      MailApp.sendEmail({
        to: adminEmail,
        subject: adminSubject,
        body: adminPlain,
        htmlBody: buildAdminWaitlistHtml_(data),
        name: 'UMKM Naik Kelas'
      });
      adminSent = true;
    } catch (err) {
      error += (error ? ' | ' : '') + 'Admin: ' + String(err.message || err);
    }
  }

  return { participantSent, adminSent, adminEmail, error };
}

function getAdminEmail_() {
  const configured = cleanText_(PropertiesService.getScriptProperties().getProperty('ADMIN_EMAIL'));
  if (isValidEmail_(configured)) return configured;

  if (isValidEmail_(ADMIN_EMAIL)) return ADMIN_EMAIL;

  const effective = cleanText_(Session.getEffectiveUser().getEmail());
  return isValidEmail_(effective) ? effective : '';
}

function escapeHtml_(value) {
  return String(value || '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;')
    .replace(/'/g, '&#39;');
}


function readUtm_(p) {
  return {
    utm_source: cleanText_(p.utm_source),
    utm_medium: cleanText_(p.utm_medium),
    utm_campaign: cleanText_(p.utm_campaign),
    utm_content: cleanText_(p.utm_content),
    utm_term: cleanText_(p.utm_term)
  };
}

function validDiagnosisScore_(score) {
  return Number.isInteger(Number(score)) && Number(score) >= 4 && Number(score) <= 12;
}

function classifyProspect_(averageScore, problem, target30) {
  const problemIsClear = cleanText_(problem).length >= 15;
  const targetIsClear = cleanText_(target30).length >= 10;
  if (averageScore <= 6 && problemIsClear && targetIsClear) return 'Prospek Panas';
  if (averageScore <= 9) return 'Prospek Hangat';
  return 'Prospek Dingin';
}

function ensureSheetColumns_(ss, name, headers) {
  let sheet = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sheet) sheet = ss.insertSheet(name);

  const lastColumn = Math.max(sheet.getLastColumn(), 1);
  const existing = sheet.getLastRow() > 0
    ? sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, lastColumn).getDisplayValues()[0].map(String)
    : [];

  if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
  } else {
    const missing = headers.filter((header) => !existing.includes(header));
    if (missing.length) {
      sheet.getRange(1, sheet.getLastColumn() + 1, 1, missing.length).setValues([missing]);
    }
  }

  sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  const width = sheet.getLastColumn();
  sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, width)
    .setBackground('#7d1514')
    .setFontColor('#ffffff')
    .setFontWeight('bold');
  return sheet;
}

function getHeaderMap_(sheet) {
  const width = sheet.getLastColumn();
  if (!width) return {};
  const headers = sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, width).getDisplayValues()[0];
  const map = {};
  headers.forEach((header, index) => { if (header) map[String(header)] = index + 1; });
  return map;
}

function appendObjectRow_(sheet, preferredHeaders, valuesByHeader) {
  ensureSheetColumns_(sheet.getParent(), sheet.getName(), preferredHeaders);
  const headerMap = getHeaderMap_(sheet);
  const width = sheet.getLastColumn();
  const row = Array(width).fill('');
  Object.keys(valuesByHeader).forEach((header) => {
    if (headerMap[header]) row[headerMap[header] - 1] = valuesByHeader[header];
  });
  sheet.appendRow(row);
}

function updateObjectRow_(sheet, rowNumber, valuesByHeader) {
  const headerMap = getHeaderMap_(sheet);
  Object.keys(valuesByHeader).forEach((header) => {
    if (headerMap[header]) sheet.getRange(rowNumber, headerMap[header]).setValue(valuesByHeader[header]);
  });
}

function findRowByHeaderValue_(sheet, header, value) {
  const map = getHeaderMap_(sheet);
  const column = map[header];
  if (!column || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) return 0;
  const needle = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  const values = sheet.getRange(2, column, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i += 1) {
    if (String(values[i][0] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === needle) return i + 2;
  }
  return 0;
}

function eventExistsByHeaders_(sheet, eventName, email) {
  const map = getHeaderMap_(sheet);
  if (!map['Event'] || !map['Email'] || sheet.getLastRow() < 2) return false;
  const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues();
  return rows.some((row) =>
    String(row[map['Event'] - 1] || '').trim() === eventName &&
    String(row[map['Email'] - 1] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === String(email || '').trim().toLowerCase()
  );
}

function getChecklistAttachment_() {
  const bytes = Utilities.base64Decode(CHECKLIST_PDF_BASE64);
  return Utilities.newBlob(bytes, 'application/pdf', 'Checklist_Diagnosis_10_Medan_UMKM.pdf');
}

function ensureFollowUpQueue_(ss, lead) {
  const headers = [
    'Email', 'Nama', 'Hari', 'Due At', 'Status', 'Last Sent', 'Error',
    'Source', 'Page', 'UTM Source', 'UTM Medium', 'UTM Campaign',
    'Medan #1', 'Medan #2', 'Medan #3', 'Subjek/WA', 'Pesan WA'
  ];
  const sheet = ensureSheetColumns_(ss, FOLLOWUP_SHEET_NAME, headers);
  const map = getHeaderMap_(sheet);
  const rows = sheet.getLastRow() >= 2
    ? sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn()).getDisplayValues()
    : [];
  const alreadyQueued = rows.some((row) =>
    String(row[map['Email'] - 1] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === lead.email.toLowerCase()
  );
  if (alreadyQueued) return;

  const baseDue = nextFollowUpAnchor_();
  [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5].forEach((day) => {
    const due = new Date(baseDue.getTime() + day * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
    const content = followUpContent_(day, lead.name, [lead.medan1, lead.medan2, lead.medan3]);
    appendObjectRow_(sheet, headers, {
      'Email': safeCell_(lead.email),
      'Nama': safeCell_(lead.name),
      'Hari': day,
      'Due At': due,
      'Status': 'Menunggu',
      'Last Sent': '',
      'Error': '',
      'Source': safeCell_(lead.source),
      'Page': safeCell_(lead.page),
      'UTM Source': safeCell_(lead.utm.utm_source),
      'UTM Medium': safeCell_(lead.utm.utm_medium),
      'UTM Campaign': safeCell_(lead.utm.utm_campaign),
      'Medan #1': safeCell_(lead.medan1),
      'Medan #2': safeCell_(lead.medan2),
      'Medan #3': safeCell_(lead.medan3),
      'Subjek/WA': safeCell_(content.subject),
      'Pesan WA': safeCell_(content.plain)
    });
  });
}

function nextFollowUpAnchor_() {
  const now = new Date();
  const tz = 'Asia/Jakarta';
  const localDate = Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'yyyy-MM-dd');
  const localHour = Number(Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'H'));
  const localMinute = Number(Utilities.formatDate(now, tz, 'm'));

  // Anchor kirim sekitar 16.00 WIB, tetap berada di jendela 15.00-17.00.
  let anchor = new Date(localDate + 'T16:00:00+07:00');
  if (localHour > 16 || (localHour === 16 && localMinute > 59)) {
    anchor = new Date(anchor.getTime() + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
  } else if (localHour >= 15 && now > anchor) {
    anchor = now;
  }
  return anchor;
}

function isFollowUpWindow_() {
  const hour = Number(Utilities.formatDate(new Date(), 'Asia/Jakarta', 'H'));
  return hour >= 15 && hour < 17;
}

function installFollowUpTrigger() {
  const exists = ScriptApp.getProjectTriggers().some((trigger) => trigger.getHandlerFunction() === 'processFollowUpQueue');
  if (!exists) ScriptApp.newTrigger('processFollowUpQueue').timeBased().everyHours(1).create();
  return 'Trigger follow-up aktif.';
}

function processFollowUpQueue() {
  // Follow-up hanya dikirim pada jendela 15.00-17.00 WIB.
  if (!isFollowUpWindow_()) return 'Di luar jendela follow-up 15.00-17.00 WIB.';

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const sheet = ensureSheetColumns_(ss, FOLLOWUP_SHEET_NAME, [
    'Email', 'Nama', 'Hari', 'Due At', 'Status', 'Last Sent', 'Error',
    'Source', 'Page', 'UTM Source', 'UTM Medium', 'UTM Campaign',
    'Medan #1', 'Medan #2', 'Medan #3', 'Subjek/WA', 'Pesan WA'
  ]);
  const map = getHeaderMap_(sheet);
  if (sheet.getLastRow() < 2) return;

  const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 1, sheet.getLastRow() - 1, sheet.getLastColumn()).getValues();
  const now = new Date();

  rows.forEach((row, index) => {
    const status = String(row[map['Status'] - 1] || '');
    const due = row[map['Due At'] - 1];
    if (status !== 'Menunggu' || !(due instanceof Date) || due > now) return;

    const data = {
      email: String(row[map['Email'] - 1] || '').trim(),
      name: String(row[map['Nama'] - 1] || '').trim(),
      day: Number(row[map['Hari'] - 1] || 0),
      medans: [
        String(row[map['Medan #1'] - 1] || '').trim(),
        String(row[map['Medan #2'] - 1] || '').trim(),
        String(row[map['Medan #3'] - 1] || '').trim()
      ]
    };
    const result = sendFollowUpEmail_(data);
    const sheetRow = index + 2;
    sheet.getRange(sheetRow, map['Status']).setValue(result.ok ? 'Terkirim' : 'Gagal');
    sheet.getRange(sheetRow, map['Last Sent']).setValue(new Date());
    sheet.getRange(sheetRow, map['Error']).setValue(result.error || '');
  });
}

function sendFollowUpEmail_(data) {
  const content = followUpContent_(data.day, data.name, data.medans || []);
  const options = {
    name: 'UMKM Naik Kelas',
    htmlBody: content.html
  };

  try {
    GmailApp.sendEmail(data.email, content.subject, content.plain, options);
    return { ok: true, transport: 'GmailApp', error: '' };
  } catch (gmailError) {
    try {
      MailApp.sendEmail({
        to: data.email,
        subject: content.subject,
        body: content.plain,
        htmlBody: content.html,
        name: 'UMKM Naik Kelas'
      });
      return { ok: true, transport: 'MailApp', error: '' };
    } catch (mailError) {
      return {
        ok: false,
        error: 'GmailApp: ' + String(gmailError.message || gmailError) +
          ' | MailApp: ' + String(mailError.message || mailError)
      };
    }
  }
}

function followUpContent_(day, name, medans) {

  const firstName = escapeHtml_(rawName.split(/\s+/)[0] || rawName);
  const medanList = (medans || []).filter(Boolean).join(', ');
  const waitlistUrl = 'https://umkmnaikkelas.id/waitlist';

  const items = {
    0: {
      subject: 'Terima kasih sudah daftar waitlist',
      body:
        'Terima kasih sudah mengisi waitlist pendampingan.\n' +
        'Saya sudah baca 3 medan terendah Anda: ' + (medanList || '[3 medan Anda]') + '.\n' +
        'Dalam 1–2 hari saya review dan kirim undangan sesi jika cocok.\n' +
        'Sementara itu, simpan checklist Anda. Kita akan pakai sebagai peta.'
    },
    1: {
      subject: 'Kenapa saya fokus ke 10 medan',
      body:
        'Dulu saya pikir masalah usaha selalu soal promosi.\n' +
        'Setelah diagnosis 10 medan, saya sadar: masalah saya ada di Keuangan dan Operasional. Bukan di Pemasaran.\n' +
        'Sejak itu saya berhenti banting harga, dan mulai benahi sistem.\n' +
        'Anda sudah tahu 3 medan terlemah Anda. Itu titik mulai yang tepat.'
    },
    2: {
      subject: 'Dari skor 5 ke 9 dalam 30 hari',
      body:
        'Seorang klien skor Keuangannya 5 (rawan).\n' +
        'Kami fokus 1 hal: pisahkan uang usaha dan pribadi.\n' +
        'Dalam 30 hari, skornya naik ke 9.\n' +
        'Bukan karena tambah promosi. Tapi karena kas tidak bocor lagi.\n' +
        'Anda punya medan serupa? Balas pesan ini.'
    },
    3: {
      subject: '3 slot pendampingan September',
      body:
        'Saya buka 3 slot pendampingan untuk September.\n' +
        'Fokus: 3 medan terlemah Anda, 4 minggu, via WA/Zoom.\n' +
        'Jika Anda serius, balas "SIAP" dan saya kirim detailnya.\n' +
        'Jika belum, tidak apa-apa. Tetap dapat tips dari saya.'
    },
    4: {
      subject: '"Saya sibuk" dan "Saya tidak bisa online lama"',
      body:
        'Dua keberatan yang sering saya dengar:\n\n' +
        '1. "Saya sibuk." → Cukup 1 sesi 45 menit per minggu.\n' +
        '2. "Saya tidak bisa online lama." → Kita pakai WA, tidak perlu video terus.\n' +
        'Pendampingan ini dirancang untuk pemilik UMKM yang aktivitasnya terbatas.'
    },
    5: {
      subject: 'Slot ditutup 30 September',
      body:
        'Ini pengingat terakhir.\n' +
        'Slot pendampingan September ditutup 30 September.\n' +
        'Setelah itu, saya fokus ke klien yang sudah masuk.\n' +
        'Jika Anda ingin, balas "SIAP" hari ini.'
    }
  };

  const item = items[day] || items[5];
  const plain = 'Halo ' + rawName + ',\n\n' + item.body + '\n\n— W. Gunawan';
  const htmlBody = escapeHtml_(item.body).replace(/\n/g, '<br>');
  const html = `
    <div style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;color:#222;line-height:1.6;">
      <div style="background:#8c0d10;color:#fff;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;">
        <div style="font-size:20px;font-weight:700;">UMKM Naik Kelas</div>
        <div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:4px;opacity:.9;">Pendampingan UMKM</div>
      </div>
      <div style="border:1px solid #eee;border-top:0;padding:24px;border-radius:0 0 12px 12px;background:#fff;">
        <p>Halo <strong>${firstName}</strong>,</p>
        <p>${htmlBody}</p>
        <div style="text-align:center;margin:24px 0;">
          <a href="${waitlistUrl}" style="display:inline-block;background:#8c0d10;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:700;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:8px;">Buka Halaman Waitlist</a>
        </div>
        <p style="margin-top:18px;">— W. Gunawan</p>
        <div style="border-top:1px solid #eee;margin-top:22px;padding-top:16px;font-size:13px;color:#666;">
          <strong style="color:#222;">UMKM Naik Kelas</strong><br>
          <a href="https://umkmnaikkelas.id/waitlist" style="color:#8c0d10;text-decoration:none;">umkmnaikkelas.id/waitlist</a>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>`;
  return { subject: item.subject, plain, html };
}

function testEmailTransport() {
  const result = sendFollowUpEmail_({ email: ADMIN_EMAIL, name: 'Tes Email', day: 0, medans: ['Pemasaran', 'Keuangan', 'Operasional'] });
  Logger.log(JSON.stringify(result));
  return result;

function ensureLeadDashboard_(ss) {
  let sheet = ss.getSheetByName(DASHBOARD_SHEET_NAME);
  if (!sheet) sheet = ss.insertSheet(DASHBOARD_SHEET_NAME);
  if (sheet.getRange('A1').getValue() === 'DASHBOARD LEAD MAGNET & WAITLIST') return;

  sheet.clear();
  sheet.getRange('A1:H1').merge().setValue('DASHBOARD LEAD MAGNET & WAITLIST');
  sheet.getRange('A1:H1').setBackground('#7d1514').setFontColor('#ffffff').setFontWeight('bold').setHorizontalAlignment('center');

  sheet.getRange('A3:B8').setValues([
    ['Metrik','Nilai'],
    ['Lead Opt-in', `=MAX(COUNTA('${EMAIL_LEADS_SHEET_NAME}'!C2:C),0)`],
    ['Download', `=COUNTIF('${EMAIL_EVENTS_SHEET_NAME}'!B:B,"LeadMagnetDownload")`],
    ['Waitlist', `=MAX(COUNTA('${WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME}'!C2:C),0)`],
    ['Closing', `=COUNTIF('${WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME}'!J:J,"Closing")+COUNTIF('${WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME}'!J:J,"Membeli")`],
    ['Download → Waitlist', `=IFERROR(B6/B5,0)`]
  ]);
  sheet.getRange('D3:E7').setValues([
    ['Segment','Jumlah'],
    ['Prospek Panas', `=COUNTIF('${WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME}'!R:R,"Prospek Panas")`],
    ['Prospek Hangat', `=COUNTIF('${WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME}'!R:R,"Prospek Hangat")`],
    ['Prospek Dingin', `=COUNTIF('${WAITLIST_SHEET_NAME}'!R:R,"Prospek Dingin")`],
    ['Waitlist → Closing', `=IFERROR(B7/B6,0)`]
  ]);
  sheet.getRange('A3:B3').setBackground('#eee6d7').setFontWeight('bold');
  sheet.getRange('D3:E3').setBackground('#eee6d7').setFontWeight('bold');
  sheet.getRange('B8').setNumberFormat('0.0%');
  sheet.getRange('E7').setNumberFormat('0.0%');
  sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
  sheet.autoResizeColumns(1, 5);
}

// ---------------- Legacy SAFE #6 handlers: kept unchanged in behavior ----------------
function saveLegacyLead_(p) {
  const name = cleanText_(p.name);
  const whatsapp = cleanText_(p.whatsapp);
  const source = cleanText_(p.source || 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan');
  const page = cleanText_(p.page);

  if (!name || !whatsapp) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Nama dan WhatsApp wajib diisi.' });
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(LEADS_SHEET_NAME);
  if (!sheet) throw new Error('Tab Leads tidak ditemukan.');

  sheet.appendRow([
    new Date(), safeCell_(name), safeCell_(whatsapp), safeCell_(source), safeCell_(page), 'Baru', '', ''
  ]);

  return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'lead', message: 'Lead berhasil disimpan.' });
}

function saveLegacyEvent_(p) {
  const eventName = cleanText_(p.event);
  const name = cleanText_(p.name);
  const whatsapp = cleanText_(p.whatsapp);
  const source = cleanText_(p.source || 'umkmnaikkelas.id - Checklist Diagnosis 10 Medan');
  const page = cleanText_(p.page);
  const allowedEvents = ['WhatsAppConfirmationClick', 'LeadMagnetDownload'];

  if (!allowedEvents.includes(eventName)) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'Event tidak dikenali.' });
  }
  if (!whatsapp) {
    return jsonResponse_({ ok: false, error: 'WhatsApp diperlukan untuk menghubungkan event dengan lead.' });
  }

  const ss = SpreadsheetApp.openById(SPREADSHEET_ID);
  const sheet = ss.getSheetByName(EVENTS_SHEET_NAME);
  if (!sheet) throw new Error('Tab Events tidak ditemukan.');

  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow >= 2) {
    const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 2, lastRow - 1, 3).getValues();
    const duplicate = rows.some((row) =>
      String(row[0] || '').trim() === eventName &&
      String(row[2] || '').trim() === whatsapp
    );
    if (duplicate) {
      return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'event', duplicate: true, message: 'Event sudah pernah tercatat.' });
    }
  }

  sheet.appendRow([
    new Date(), safeCell_(eventName), safeCell_(name), safeCell_(whatsapp), safeCell_(source), safeCell_(page)
  ]);
  return jsonResponse_({ ok: true, type: 'event', message: 'Event berhasil disimpan.' });
}

function ensureSheet_(ss, name, headers) {
  let sheet = ss.getSheetByName(name);
  if (!sheet) sheet = ss.insertSheet(name);

  if (sheet.getLastRow() === 0) {
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length).setValues([headers]);
    sheet.setFrozenRows(1);
    sheet.getRange(1, 1, 1, headers.length)
      .setBackground('#7d1514')
      .setFontColor('#ffffff')
      .setFontWeight('bold');
    sheet.autoResizeColumns(1, headers.length);
  }
  return sheet;
}

function findRowByValue_(sheet, columnNumber, value) {
  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return 0;

  const needle = String(value || '').trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!needle) return 0;

  const values = sheet.getRange(2, columnNumber, lastRow - 1, 1).getValues();

  for (let i = 0; i < values.length; i += 1) {
    if (String(values[i][0] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === needle) {
      return i + 2;
    }
  }

  return 0;
}

function existsInColumn_(sheet, columnNumber, value) {
  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return false;
  const values = sheet.getRange(2, columnNumber, lastRow - 1, 1).getDisplayValues();
  return values.some((row) => String(row[0] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === value.toLowerCase());
}

function eventExists_(sheet, eventName, email) {
  const lastRow = sheet.getLastRow();
  if (lastRow < 2) return false;
  const rows = sheet.getRange(2, 2, lastRow - 1, 3).getDisplayValues();
  return rows.some((row) =>
    String(row[0] || '').trim() === eventName &&
    String(row[2] || '').trim().toLowerCase() === email.toLowerCase()
  );
}

function isValidEmail_(email) {
  return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]{2,}$/.test(String(email || '').trim());
}

function cleanText_(value) {
  return String(value || '').trim().slice(0, 1000);
}

function safeCell_(value) {
  const s = String(value || '');
  return /^[=+\-@]/.test(s) ? "'" + s : s;
}

function jsonResponse_(payload) {
  return ContentService
    .createTextOutput(JSON.stringify(payload))
    .setMimeType(ContentService.MimeType.JSON);
}
